headline.lead: AI picks Klaviyo in 47 of 60 answers. Its revenue-reporting and automation reasons are out of date. Address these first on the comparison page.

points.text: Klaviyo is picked in 47 of 60 answers. GetResponse wins 3, all on price or all-in-one value.
“Klaviyo has better revenue reporting” comes from training data: 18 of 20 search-off answers say it, 13 of 30 live ones. GetResponse now reports revenue per message and per workflow.
Price is the main reason AI ever picks GetResponse, but it only holds at bigger lists. At 1k contacts the plan with abandoned cart costs $59 against Klaviyo's $30.

priority.reason: Top store need and a widely repeated weakness. Browse abandonment and price drop campaigns are new (Apr 2026) and answers miss them. Back-in-stock is still missing, so say so.
The clearest training-data gap: 90% of search-off answers make the claim, 43% of live ones. GetResponse now reports revenue per message and workflow (Marketer and up). Easy win.
The main reason AI picks GetResponse at all. True at 10k contacts, not at 1k on the plan stores need. Show a list-size table so the claim survives a check.
High need, and it holds: the Shopify app has 1 review rated 1.0. Cover it honestly. This is a product fix more than a page fix.
Live search adds this objection: 4 of 20 search-off answers raise it, 10 of 30 live ones. Starter has no abandoned cart. Name the plan that does, up front.
Repeated almost everywhere and true: AI recommendations are Enterprise only; no predictive CLV or churn found. Don't contest it. Narrow it.
SMS is Enterprise only (MAX). Live answers raise it less than training data does (33% vs 75%), so one honest line is enough.
Few answers make it and no primary source settles it. Don't lead with it.
Already credited and true (Creator plan). Low store need, so it goes last.

gapNote: Live search barely moves the pick: Klaviyo 19 of 20 with search off, 17 of 20 with it on (Claude and ChatGPT). ChatGPT cited getresponse.com in 9 of 10 live answers and still credited Klaviyo with better revenue attribution. The page needs plain, dated statements on revenue attribution and the new flows, so live engines have something to quote. GetResponse's own comparison page already ranks #1 on Google for 5 of 10 prompts, yet AI Overviews pick it once and leave it out of “Klaviyo alternatives”.
how: 10 fixed prompts, the same for every engine, asked from the US (VPN), logged out. Prompts 1 and 2 swap the name order; every engine answered the same both ways.
Claude: a clean helper, search off then on. ChatGPT: OpenAI API (gpt-5.2), search off then forced on.
Gemini: web app. It decides when to search, so it counts as live only. Google: the AI Overview, plus where getresponse.com ranks.
Training data = Claude + ChatGPT with search off (20 answers). Live = Claude + ChatGPT with search on, plus Google (30). Gemini is left out of this table.
Claims are tagged per answer. ChatGPT tags are keyword matches, so allow ±1–2 per claim.
Primary sources = GetResponse's pricing page, blog, help docs and Shopify listing. Klaviyo prices come from third-party sources.
Not covered yet: logged-in runs, non-US results, Perplexity and Copilot.
